content.text:
# Recurring problems in BGL and OpenStack, and what to look at first

**Scope:** I used the full range of both tables, with no filters. BGL runs from 3 Jun 2005 to 4 Jan 2006 and OpenStack from 14 to 17 May 2017, both in UTC. Neither table has data before its own range. To see change, I compared the later half of each range with the earlier half: BGL from 19 Sep 2005 against the period before it, OpenStack from 16 May 04:00 against the period before it. Both halves are only partly covered by data, so the tool gives counts for each half but no percentage change, and nothing below is called "new".

## What the logs show

**Overall size.** BGL has 4,747,963 entries [Q51] and 1,012,140 of them are warning level or worse [Q56]. Node OS logs the most severe entries: 626,756 fatal kernel entries. HPC Applications has 228,536 fatal entries, Control System 88,529 errors, and Hardware Reliability about 68,000 entries from warning to failure [Q51]. OpenStack is quiet by comparison: 3,130 entries at warning or worse out of 207,636 [Q57][Q51].
